verses.english: This was said by the Buddha, the Perfected One: that is what I heard.
“Mendicants, these two are bound for a place of loss, bound for hell, if they don’t give up this fault.

verses.pali: Yo ca abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño, yo ca paripuṇṇaṁ parisuddhaṁ brahmacariyaṁ carantaṁ amūlakena abrahmacariyena anuddhaṁseti.
verses.english: Someone who is unchaste, but claims to be chaste; and someone who makes a groundless accusation of unchastity against a person whose chastity is pure.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve āpāyikā nerayikā idamappahāyā”ti.
verses.english: These are the two who are bound for a place of loss, bound for hell, if they don’t give up this fault.”

verses.pali: Yo vāpi katvā na karomi cāha;
verses.english: as does one who denies what they did.
Both are equal in the hereafter,
Many who wear a scrap of ocher cloth
Being wicked, they are reborn in hell
It’d be better for the immoral and unrestrained
than to eat the nation’s alms.”

verses.pali: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
verses.english: This too is a matter that was spoken by the Blessed One: that is what I heard.
